timecoded_text_to_speech.text: 5 Asteroids Speeding Towards Earth
From 17 feet to 173 feet, check details.
NASA has revealed key details about 5 asteroids such as their size, distance, speed and
more, which are set to make close approaches to Earth in the coming days.
Asteroid 2023 FO3 Asteroid 2023 FO3, which is between 39 feet and 92 wide, will make its
closest approach to Earth today, March 31st.
The asteroid is already rushing towards Earth at a speed of 36,651 km per hour, and will
miss the planet by a distance of just 2.5 million km.
Asteroid 2023 FF7 another asteroid named Asteroid 2023 FF7 is heading for Earth and will make
a close approach tomorrow, April 1st.
This asteroid, with a width between 36 feet and 82 feet, is heading for Earth at a blistering
speed of 38,841 km per hour.
It will miss Earth at a distance of 3.3 million km.
Asteroid 2023 FZ10 Asteroid 2023 FZ10, which is between 17 feet and 39 feet wide, is heading
for Earth and will make a close approach tomorrow, April 1st.
This asteroid is heading for Earth at a speed of 9,919 km per hour.
It will miss Earth at a close distance of 1 million km.
The 2022 FY6 Asteroid 2023 FY6 will make its closest approach to Earth on April 2nd.
It is between 78 feet and 173 feet wide, as per NASA.
The asteroid will come as close as 3.8 million km near Earth and is already moving at a fiery
speed of 81,013 km per hour.
The 2022 G03 the 5th asteroid, with a width of between 36 feet and 82 feet, is named
Asteroid 2022 G03 and will be making its closest Earth approach on April 2nd.
It will come as close as 6.5 million km, according to NASA.
The asteroid is moving at a fearsome speed of 41,740 km per hour.
